newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Transaction Network cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Transaction Network cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cuts its rating on Transaction Network Services Inc to buy from strong buy based on company contract re-negotiations that are hurting revenues and margins.
-- In written research, Hambrecht said the long-term outlook for the company remains excellent.
-- Shares were trading off marginally at 14-1/4 in midmorning exchange trade.
-- Hambrecht analyst Steven Birer cut his Q3 1996 earnings estimate to $0.15 a share on $14.8 million in revenues from $0.17 a share on $15.1 million in revenues.
-- He cut his Q4 1996 estimate to $0.17 a share on $15.3 million in revenues versus a previous $0.20 and $15.9 million, respectively.
-- 1997 earnings estimates went to $0.70 a share on 68.1 million in revenues from $0.80 a share and $71.4 million.
